messages:
support_jordan: customer reports intermittent 403s right after we rotated the KMS key and ran vault rewrap. only some lambda instances in eu-west-1 fail, others succeed. error in logs: "permission denied: decrypt". request ids: req-az12, req-bz45. they say this started immediately after rotation. they passed the new key alias to the Vault auto-unseal config. any quick checks?

devops-anna: can you paste the exact rotation steps they ran and the vault rewrap command? also which service account is Vault using to call KMS? if the IAM role lost decrypt on the new key that would explain it.

support_jordan: steps they listed: 1) created new KMS key (alias kms/redwood-eu-rot-2026) 2) updated KMS alias in vault unseal config 3) ran aws kms schedule-key-deletion? no they say they rotated using alias re-pointing 4) ran `vault operator rekey` (they said) then `vault write sys/rewrap` (not sure of exact path) 5) restarted some stacks. attached snippet from their curl test:```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
# -> HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
# {"error":"permission denied: decrypt"}
```

vault-bot: rewrap job job-342 completed with status: PARTIAL_SUCCESS (50/100 items rewrapped).

eng-sam: partial rewrap looks suspect. if rewrap didn't finish some wrapped keys will still point to old CMK which may have no decrypt for the Vault IAM principal. please check CloudTrail KMS Decrypt events for the Vault role and look for failures around the timestamps. also confirm the vault token cache/agent cache hasn't kept old wrapped values.

devops-anna: quick repro checklist for customer to try (can help run if needed):
1) run `aws kms describe-key --key-id <new-key-id>` and confirm key state = Enabled and KeyPolicy includes the vault IAM principal with kms:Decrypt
2) check CloudTrail: `LookupEvents --LookupAttributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt` filter by principal
3) run this on a failing lambda instance shell (if accessible) to see raw error:
```
AWS_LOG_LEVEL=debug vault kv get -format=json secret/service-api || true
# or curl with x-request-id header to match logs
```
4) restart vault-agent sidecar / pod on one failing replica to force fresh unwrap

security-lee: also verify cross-region key aliases. sometimes alias re-pointing didn't propagate to all regions and we end up with mixed keys (new alias in eu-west-1 but some infra calling eu-central alias). check alias ARN & region in the app config. if the key was created with a different account/partition that will block decrypts too.

support_jordan: customer tried restarting vault-agent on one failing replica and it recovered for that instance. they still have ~20% of replicas failing. will collect CloudTrail decrypt denies.

eng-sam: likely root cause = partial rewrap + IAM policy missing decrypt on new CMK for Vault principal + stale agent cache. Mitigations: complete rewrap (retry with small batch), add temporary KMS key policy to allow decrypt for old and new principals, and force agent/pod restarts. Could also fallback to old key if you can re-enable it short term.

devops-anna: @support_jordan can you escalate to infra with the failing request ids and attach CloudTrail events plus the output of `vault operator rewrap status` and `vault status`? I'll start a rewrap job in infra account with higher retries.

support_jordan: on it. capturing logs and CloudTrail, will DM credentials and request ids to @devops-anna. marking this P1 for support. thanks all :thumbsup:
